name: rag-doctor-vscode
description: Local VS Code diagnostics for RAG code, prompts, responses, and supported logs with evidence-linked fixes.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Workspace scanning and app connection are available only after the workspace is trusted. RAG Doctor reads selected workspace files and can add a local connector file after confirmation.

ragDoctor.backendPath.description: Optional path to a local RAG Doctor backend root containing backend/app/api/server.py. The packaged analyzer is used by default.

ragDoctor.pythonPath.description: Python executable with the analyzer dependencies installed. Defaults to a nearby .venv, then the system Python.

ragDoctor.backendPort.description: Loopback port for the local RAG Doctor analyzer.

ragDoctor.includeRunContent.description: Include sanitized prompt, answer, and retrieved passage text in local diagnosis. Off by default; metadata-only analysis cannot verify factual correctness.

ragDoctor.localModelEndpoint.description: Loopback-only Ollama-compatible chat endpoint used by the RAG investigator. Workspace evidence is never sent to a remote endpoint.

ragDoctor.localModelName.description: Installed local model name for AI investigation, for example qwen3:4b. The model runs in your local Ollama server.

ragDoctor.localModelThinking.description: Enable Ollama reasoning for RAG investigations. Disable for faster responses or models that do not support thinking.
